test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)

question: What is the codename of the Low-Level Transportable Radar (LLTR) to be procured by the Ministry of Defence (MoD) with Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) at a cost of ₹2,906 crore in March 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ashwini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Low-Level Transportable Radar (LLTR)**, codenamed **Ashwini**, is a crucial radar system to be procured by the **Ministry of Defence (MoD)** in collaboration with **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)**.
 
• The radar is designed to enhance **air surveillance** and is particularly effective at **low altitudes**.
 
• This system will significantly improve the **Indian Air Force's (IAF)** capability to detect and track **low-flying aerial threats**.
 
• The contract for procuring the Ashwini radar system is valued at **₹2,906 crore**, showcasing its strategic and operational importance.
 
• The radar system is indigenously developed under the **'Make in India' initiative**, emphasizing the Indian government’s focus on achieving self-reliance in defense technology.
 
• The Ashwini system is mobile and can be easily deployed in **remote and high-altitude areas**, ensuring flexibility and swift operational readiness.
 
• This radar system will play a vital role in strengthening the country’s **air defense network** by providing accurate and real-time data to respond to potential threats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vayu**__

 __
 
• The name **Vayu** refers to the **god of wind** in Hindu mythology and is often associated with air or atmosphere.
 
• It symbolizes the **force of air**, but it is not linked to the specific radar system discussed here.
 
 
 
• **Surya**__
 __
 
• **Surya** is the **Sun God** in Hindu mythology, representing energy, light, and life.
 
• While the term signifies power and brilliance, it is unrelated to the **LLTR Ashwini radar system**.
 
 
 
• **Indra**__
 
 
• **Indra** is the **king of the gods** and the god of rain and thunder in Hindu mythology.
 
• It is used in several other defense-related projects but does not pertain to the radar system being procured in this case.
